behavior: Quiet keeps every config pair the environment already carries and appends its own after them, so both the caller's keys and Quiet's apply.
verification: cd cli && out="$(go test ./internal/gittest -run '^(TestQuietKeepsTheCallersConfig|TestQuietAppendsAfterAForeignEnvironment)$' -v -count=1)" && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietKeepsTheCallersConfig' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietAppendsAfterAForeignEnvironment'

behavior: A second Quiet call in a re-executed test binary adds nothing: no duplicate pairs and no nested system config.
verification: cd cli && out="$(go test ./internal/gittest -run '^(TestQuietAcceptsItsOwnKeys|TestQuietDoesNotIncludeItsOwnFile)$' -v -count=1)" && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietAcceptsItsOwnKeys' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietDoesNotIncludeItsOwnFile'

behavior: The refusals that must survive still panic: a malformed GIT_CONFIG_COUNT and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM.
verification: cd cli && out="$(go test ./internal/gittest -run '^(TestQuietRefusesAMalformedCount|TestQuietRefusesNoSystem)$' -v -count=1)" && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietRefusesAMalformedCount' && printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestQuietRefusesNoSystem'

behavior: The internal/cmd test binary starts and exits cleanly under the harness environment that used to abort it at TestMain.
verification: cd cli && GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=3 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=safe.bareRepository GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=explicit GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1=credential.interactive GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1=never GIT_CONFIG_KEY_2=core.fsmonitor GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_2=false go test ./internal/cmd -run '^$' -count=1
